item.title: [IGNITE-1692] [Test] DataStreamProcessorSelfTest.testReplicated fails sometimes.

commit 0ae52562db085e795b441a61a135ee30dd1815fb
Author: Ilya Lantukh <ilantukh@gridgain.com>
Date: 2015-12-02T12:02:25Z

Test Suite for DataStreamProcessorSelfTest.testReplicated.

Github user ilantukh closed the pull request at:

https://github.com/apache/ignite/pull/286

The reason of this problem is race condition: sometimes test starts to put data before nodes converge to the same affinity topology version.
This problem is not specific to testReplicated() method, other test methods fail too.
I think calling GridCommonAbstractTest::awaitPartitionMapExchange() after initialization will fix this problem.

Done.

Changed Ignition.start() order so that servers will start before clients and added GridCommonAbstractTest::awaitPartitionMapExchange() call after initialization.

Successfully tested on TeamCity.

Semyon, could you please review code changes in https://github.com/apache/ignite/pull/293?

Ilya,

I think 'awaitPartitionMapExchange' calls you added are not really needed, please remove them.

Thanks
